plain: A person who invests money to make more money

webster.text: A man who has a capital or stock in trade, usually denoting a man of large property, which is or may be employed in business.

example.quote: To this, it is of importance that the confidence of cautious, sagacious capitalists, both citizens and foreigners, should be excited.
example.cite: Alexander Hamilton, Report on Manufactures (communicated to the House of Representatives, Dec. 5, 1791)
